## `neuro.array.push`

Instance method on `Array.prototype`. Variadic items live under `items`.

> Appends new elements to the end of an array, and returns the new length of the array.

## Signatures

```ts
push(input: { array: <receiver>; items: T[]; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Array.prototype.push` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
